## Description and Rationale

I am a student studying machine learning at uni and this seemed like it was right up my alley.

## Details

* Type: Independent
* Country: Australia

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(gt)

gt(tibble::tribble(
  ~id, ~forename, ~surname,  ~affiliation,
   1L,   "Xyzzy",  "XYZZY", "Undisclosed"
)
) |> cols_label(id = md("**ID**"), forename = md("**Forename**"), surname ~ md("**Surname**"), affiliation ~ md("**Affiliation**"))
```
